entries.title: Ask HN: What Hacker News comments have you bookmarked?
entries.author: pardavis
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What Hacker News comments have you bookmarked?
entries.excerpt: Frequently while browsing this site I see a comment that is profoundly insightful about culture, mindset, career, relationships, coffee grinders, etc. I realized today that I’ve always considered them in the moment and let them go. Perhaps I should have been bookmarking them and revisiting with a different perspective.
entries.guide_zh: 哪些 HN 评论让你觉得深刻到值得收藏，日后反复回看？

entries.excerpt: Please state the job location and include the keywords REMOTE, INTERNS and/or VISA when the corresponding sort of candidate is welcome.
